title: Affine base-change chart ring
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a ring map, let $I\subseteq A$, and let $a\in I$.
Define

$$
C_a(A,B,I)=B\otimes_A A[I/a].
$$

We regard $a$ as an element of $C_a(A,B,I)$ through the structural map
$A\to C_a(A,B,I)$.

blueprint_notes.text:
**Status.** Bypassed by the formalized route: the strict transform is
supplied by the API of
`WeilConjectures/Compactification/StrictTransform.lean` —
`AlgebraicGeometry.strictTransform`, its closed immersion
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosedImmersion_pullbackLift_blowup_comap`,
and the pullback square
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_strictTransformOpen` — so the
strict-transform chart rings and their cocycle are never assembled by hand.

lean.note: Exact published upstream declaration in WeilConjectures.Blowup.Affine.StrictTransformChart.lean. With contextual binders {A : Type u}, (B : Type u), [CommRing A], [CommRing B], [Algebra A B], (I : Ideal A), and (a : A), it defines BaseChangeChart as B ⊗[A] chartRing I a. This is exactly C_a(A,B,I) = B ⊗_A A[I/a], where chartRing is the recorded dependency def-nagata-blowup-chart-ring. The node context includes a ∈ I for the blow-up chart, but the same chart ring is well-defined for arbitrary a; supplying the membership proof when using the chart gives exactly the node notion. The structural A-to-C_a map is provided by the standard algebra structure on the tensor product.
